prompts:
Create byar-a.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use the attached master-side.png as the locked character and style reference; reproduce that exact man, face, hair, white muddy cloak/tabard, armor, golden insignia, kite shield and longsword in every drawing. Reference background is NOT wanted.
OUTPUT: 1536x1024 landscape PNG with genuinely transparent background, real alpha, no shadows/floor/background/text/labels/borders. Exactly EIGHT full-body figures in TWO rows of FOUR, reading left to right. Equal cells 384x512, generous transparent separation, no overlaps or clipped swords/cloaks. Same character scale throughout (fit full character and weapon inside each cell; do not vary body proportions), common boot baseline around y=490 for top row and y=1000 for bottom. Every character faces LEFT, profile/slight 3/4. All eight are independently drawn different moments, never copied or mirrored.
CHARACTER: Jaret Byar, tall lean gaunt stern man age 40, long bony hollow-cheeked face, deep-set dark eyes, thin unsmiling mouth, short dark hair grey temples, no helmet. Exact reference costume: white long cloak muddy/rain-stained torn hem, white tabard golden sunburst left breast and two gold rank knots beneath, steel breastplate/pauldrons/gauntlets/greaves, grey mail, brown boots/belts. LEFT arm carries large white kite shield with gold sunburst and gilded rim; RIGHT hand carries long straight steel longsword with gilded crossguard. Preserve the reference shield and sword size, silhouette and details across all frames, with natural perspective foreshortening only. Exactly two arms, two legs, two booted feet, anatomically correct five-finger hands.
STYLE: match reference exactly, hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art in spirit of Streets of Rage 4, confident near-black/dark-brown outlines thick outside thin inside, clean 2–3-step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded white/gold/steel/brown colors. Light upper left, gentle cool right rim, moderate baked shading. Not pixel art, 3D, photorealism or chibi. Kid-friendly, no blood.
TOP ROW WALK LEFT, measured stern march, shield forward on LEFT, longsword ready over right shoulder:
1 far left: left boot forward planted contact, right boot trailing, cloak trailing right.
2 next: passing pose, right boot moving past supporting left leg, weight raised, narrower leg stance.
3 next: right boot forward planted contact, left boot trailing, distinct opposite stride.
4 far right: passing pose, left boot moving past supporting right leg, weight raised, narrower stance distinct from frame 2.
BOTTOM ROW SWORD COMBO, shield maintained forward, sword motion anatomically driven by RIGHT arm:
5 far left GUARD: wide classic ready stance, shield forward left, sword raised over shoulder with blade pointing upper left like reference.
6 next WIND-UP: right elbow raised and sword lifted HIGH BEHIND head, blade angled upward toward right, preparing overhead cut; shield forward left.
7 next OVERHEAD CUT: right hand swinging sword down diagonally toward LEFT, blade extended diagonally down-left in front, torso rotated left and front knee deeply bent; this is mid-cut, distinctly lower sword than frame 6 and higher than frame 8.
8 far right FOLLOW-THROUGH: lean forward toward LEFT, sword held LOW in front with blade almost along ground toward LEFT, front knee bent and rear leg braced; shield still visible on left arm.
No effects, dust, motion lines. Prioritize eight separated readable figures, exact reference identity, consistent gear and distinct sequential motion.

Edit the most recent sprite sheet into the final byar-a.png. Keep 1536x1024, exactly eight characters two rows of four facing left, preserve the locked master character identity and detailed ink/cel-shaded style. REQUIRED: REMOVE ALL background entirely, genuinely transparent PNG alpha=0 around the figures, no backdrop colors at all. Preserve opaque white clothes and shields. No checkerboard painted into image. Preserve clean silhouette edges. Also correct walk top row: third figure must have opposite leg forward from first, fourth must have opposite leg passing from second. All figures same scale, weapon and shield dimensions consistent. Keep sword combo bottom row guard, high windup, diagonal down-left cut, low-left follow-through, but contain every sword within its own column and leave clear transparent gaps. All boots baseline same per row. Full figures with margins, no text, no effects. Generate actual transparency using the transparent-background output.
note: Best of three retained. Exactly eight left-facing figures, four per row. PIL verifies 1536x1024 RGBA, alpha extrema 0–254, 859511 fully transparent pixels, corner and inter-cell gap alpha 0. Walk leg alternation and sword size consistency remain imperfect.
